headline: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas, Trilegal, Linklaters act on Piramal Finance ₹2,100 crore QIP
sum: Piramal Finance Limited has raised ₹2,100 crore from a qualified Institutions Placement of equity shares. Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas advised Piramal Finance on this QIP.
detail: Piramal Finance Limited has raised ₹2,100 crore from a qualified Institutions Placement of equity shares. Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas advised Piramal Finance on this QIP. The transaction team was led by Devaki Mankad (Partner, Regional Co-Head - Capital Markets - West) and Amitpal Singh (Partner), with support from Associates Niharika Payannavar, Janhavi Deshmukh, Eashaan Agrawal, Mann Agrawal, Mitali Mangalam and Riya Kumar. Yash J.
